description: Jawa.gg | Software Engineer | Boulder, CO or remote | Contract or Full Time Jawa is the marketplace for gamers - think gaming PCs, GPUs, consoles, and the like. We're a small, VC-funded team with a big business, and have been operating since 2021. We're are looking for full-stack software engineers to build and maintain our peer-to-peer marketplace. The tech stack is mostly Typescript, with Next.js, Node.js, Postgres, and other fairly standard web-tools / infra. Learn more at https://jawagg.notion.site/Full-Stack-Software-Engineer-412c...
